scope: validation only; the sealed test set was never read

explanations.research_question: An automated research loop that keeps whatever scores higher on validation will always find something to keep. Are those kept changes real improvements, or noise from trying many things?
explanations.observed_result: On the same 487 AI-written and templated proposals, replayed in 200 random orders per cell, the keep-if-better ratchet accepted 5.4 to 6.6 proposals per ordering (ordering alone gives about 6.8), Thresholdout accepted 29 to 66, and the statistical critic accepted none. In the live closed loop (1,440 proposals) ratchet runs kept 25 proposals and critic runs kept 0.
explanations.limitation: All numbers are from validation data. The sealed test set was never opened, so false-discovery rate, recall and hypotheses H1 to H4 are not computed, and we cannot say the ratchet's accepted proposals are false. The critic may also be too strict: zero acceptances leave no eligible paired comparison. Agents used each other's output, but the memory measure (H5) showed no benefit.

steps: proposer: this proposal, citing the source card and the lesson

sources.query: relative Mahalanobis distance and Mahalanobis++ feature normalization (avoid changes that are score-matched)
sources.title: A Simple Fix to Mahalanobis Distance for Improving Near-OOD Detection
sources.method: Fit class means and a pooled covariance on in-distribution feature vectors; score a sample feature \(z\) by \(\mathrm{RMD}(z)=\min_c (z-\mu_c)^T\Sigma^{-1}(z-\mu_c)-(z-\mu)^T\Sigma_{\rm all}^{-1}(z-\mu)\), where \((\mu,\Sigma_{\rm all})\) are the global feature mean/covariance. Larger RMD indicates more likely OOD (the classifier logits are not required).

lessons.text: Fusion and kNN proposals repeatedly reproduce the incumbent ranking rather than adding signal (c97212fc5303, bcd6486b108b, c5e041dfb62f); density variants likewise split between score-matching and negative gains (f389f4d782ea, 0abf80933f5d). Avoid more monotone blends or neighborhood/density reparameterizations. An untried direction is an explicitly class-conditional, uncertainty-aware score using predictive disagreement or augmentation stability.

built_from_verdicts_on.failure_reason: validation AUROC -0.0114 against the incumbent; -0.0338 against the comparator d_port_ce; stopped at gate G3
built_from_verdicts_on.rationale: Trailing within-class covariance directions encode tight in-scope constraints, but their natural scale varies by classifier-assigned intent. Class-conditional robust calibration of trailing-direction residuals highlights violations relative to the predicted intent rather than reproducing a global residual ranking.

built_from_verdicts_on.failure_reason: validation AUROC +0.0063 against the incumbent; stopped at gate G2
built_from_verdicts_on.rationale: The normalized Dirichlet concentration profile describes how evidence is distributed across intents, independently of total evidence or vacuity. A query whose predicted-intent profile is angularly unlike profiles seen for that intent is likely out-of-scope.

built_from_verdicts_on.failure_reason: validation AUROC +0.0130 against the incumbent; stopped at gate G2
built_from_verdicts_on.rationale: OOS queries should be distant from training examples across both bottleneck and encoder representations. Averaging near- and broader-neighborhood radii reduces sensitivity to a single anomalously close neighbor while retaining local support information.

built_from_verdicts_on.failure_reason: validation AUROC +0.0083 against the incumbent; stopped at gate G2
built_from_verdicts_on.rationale: Classifier energy and full encoder-space Mahalanobis distance capture complementary uncertainty signals. Mapping each score to its train-fitted empirical percentile puts both on a shared robust scale before combining their upper-tail evidence.

built_from_verdicts_on.failure_reason: validation AUROC +0.0178 against the incumbent; stopped at gate G2
built_from_verdicts_on.rationale: A shrunk diagonal covariance gives each intent its own stable and unstable feature dimensions without the noise of a full per-class covariance. Class-calibrated surprise under the classifier's predicted intent exposes representation-logit disagreement and atypical within-intent variation.

proposal.rationale: Near-OOS inputs can be unsupported by the predicted intent in bottleneck space, while far-OOS domain shifts can be unsupported in encoder space. Class-conditional train-calibrated density tails make the two distances comparable before their train-fitted additive fusion.

validation.failure_reason: validation AUROC +0.0019 against the incumbent; stopped at gate G2
